# Reference & notes

A living reference on evaluating LLM products. This grows: notes as I read and
learn, interview questions and answers refined over time, and an annotated list
of the resources this repository draws on. Everything here is written in
markdown and rendered to an offline page you can open straight off disk — the
same no-install promise the lessons make.

To add to it, drop a markdown file in `notes/` or `interview/` (copy the
`_template.md` next to them) and run `make reference`. The index below and the
offline pages regenerate from your markdown; nothing is maintained by hand
twice.

## Resources

- [Resources](resources.md) — The books, courses, and tools this repository draws on. For each: what it is, what it is best for, and which lessons it maps to. These are pointers and short summaries, not reproductions — go to the source for the real thing.

## Notes

- [Error analysis comes before metrics](notes/error-analysis.md) — The first move in evaluating an LLM product is not to pick a metric. It is to read a sample of real traces and write down, in your own words, what went wrong. The metrics come after, and they come *from* what you read.

## Interview Q&A

- [Evals fundamentals](interview/fundamentals.md) — Starter questions on the ideas everything else builds on. Grows as we brainstorm.
